text:
Clear and cold as the evening settles in. The sun set at 4:17 under a clean sky, and we're at 28 now with hardly any wind. Tonight stays quiet with a low around 23, so expect frost on the windshield first thing.

Thanksgiving looks like a dry day for the most part. It starts with some sun, then the clouds thicken by afternoon, and the high lands near 42. One model runs warmer, but I'd bet on the low 40s. The rain holds off until evening. It begins around 7 or 8, turns steady by 10, and runs until about 3 in the morning. Expect roughly half an inch to three quarters, with temperatures climbing from the low 30s into the upper 30s overnight.

The forecasters think any ice stays up in the hills, so in Burlington this is mainly a rain event. Still, with holiday travel, watch for a slick spot early in the evening. Friday stays cloudy with showers and a high near 47. Do your driving and walking Thursday before dinner, and keep the umbrella by the door.

week.blurb: Partly cloudy and cold tonight, dropping to around 23, so expect frost on the windshield first thing tomorrow.
Dry and mostly cloudy for Thanksgiving with a high near 42, then steady rain arrives Thursday night, up to three quarters of an inch.
A wet Friday, with rain early and showers the rest of the day, a high near 47 and up to half an inch; bring the umbrella.
Cloudy with a high near 46 and only spotty showers possible, so most of Saturday looks fairly dry.
Looks like the nicest day of the stretch, partly sunny and near 50, with rain holding off until after midnight.
Rain likely Monday with a high near 50, then turning colder tonight, with a low around 31 as it clears out.
Cooler Tuesday, partly sunny with a high near 43, then a chilly night in the upper 20s.
Looks quiet again Wednesday, partly sunny with a high around 44, a touch warmer than Tuesday.
